allowed_file_review: Public catalog or deposit metadata first. If the archive is accessible, save original bytes locally, hash, and release only allowlisted file and workbook structure, fixed sample/protocol facts and numerically masked early observations when identifiable. No raw rows, arbitrary worksheet headings, late values or previews that may expose endpoint performance.
qualification: Bind original sample, biomass-derived porous carbon, 3E/2E, cycling current as reported, horizon, reference and at least three separable early points. In-scope pure biomass carbon is primary; composites require separate eligibility. Unverified lineage remains reserved and unscored. For mixed material or 2E retain separate disposition.
stop: If originals or sample/test protocol are unavailable, report exact failure and do not fit. An acquired sheet is not an independent source until the originating experiment is verified. No fitting, prediction locking, endpoint reveal, formal admission or independent acceptance authorized under this screening plan.
visual: Phase 51 scheduled visual, preserving previously frozen performance unless a new qualified model benchmark exists.
